title: Course Version Published
description: Transactional-outbox event emitted once a course version is published (V0-008, docs/state-machines/PUBLICATION_STATE_MACHINE.md: COMMITTING -> PUBLISHED). The payload is the pinned version tuple, so a consumer (a notification, an analytics projector) knows exactly which content/lesson/knowledge versions a session may pin (DEC-CONTENT-005). The tenant is the institution (institution_id) - the same identifier the API carries in X-Institution-Id; the classroom event envelope's tenant_id is that concept at the realtime layer. Delivery is at least once and the consumer deduplicates on event_id (docs/data/OUTBOX_SNAPSHOT_AND_RETENTION.md); the outbox row is written in the same transaction as the publication, so a visible publication always has its event.
